en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Musanna Bin Al Waleed, from Zurara, 
from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww prayed seventy Salaat upon Hamzaas’. (i.e. exclaimed seventy Takbeers – see Hadeeth 3 below).
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from al-Muthanna’ ibn al-Walid from Zurarah from who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The Messenger of Allah said seventy Salah (prayers) for Hamzah.’”
